metadata.description: BigID API refresh token (stored securely and masked in run history)

metadata.title: BigID DSPM - Fetch Full Case Catalog Objects (Workbook On-Demand)
metadata.description: On-demand Microsoft Sentinel Playbook invoked from the BigID DSPM Workbook via ARM Action. Queries BigID (/api/v1/data-catalog/ with SIMPLE_PROJECT up to 1,000 objects) for the selected case and ingests the results into BigIDDSPMEvidence_CL via the Azure Monitor Logs Ingestion API.
prerequisites: 1. A BigID API refresh token with access to Data Catalog APIs.
2. The BigID DSPM CCF Data Connector deployed (provides the Data Collection Endpoint and BigIDDSPMCasesDCR).
postDeployment: 1. Open the BigID DSPM Posture & Case Triage Workbook, select any case in the Case & Objects Triage tab, switch to 'Pull up to 1,000 Objects from BigID (Playbook)', and click 'Fetch up to 1,000 Objects from BigID'.

releaseNotes.title: BigID DSPM - Fetch Full Case Catalog Objects (Workbook On-Demand)
notes: Initial version supporting native ARM Action execution from the BigID DSPM Workbook with ingestion into BigIDDSPMEvidence_CL.

let _caseClassifiers =
    union isfuzzy=true BigIDDSPMCaseClassifiers_CL
    | extend _clsCaseId = column_ifexists('CaseId', ''),
        _clsData = column_ifexists('classifiers', dynamic([]))
    | where isnotempty(_clsCaseId)
    | summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, _clsData) by CaseId = _clsCaseId
    | project CaseId, _joinedClassifiers = parse_json(tostring(_clsData));
BigIDDSPMCases_CL
| extend _case = parse_json(dspmCase)
| extend CaseId = tostring(_case.caseId)
| where isnotempty(CaseId)
| extend BigIDFqdn = column_ifexists('bigidFqdn', ''),
    _classifiersRaw = column_ifexists('classifiers', dynamic([]))
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, dspmCase, datasource, expand, _classifiersRaw, BigIDFqdn) by CaseId
| join kind=leftouter _caseClassifiers on CaseId
| project-away CaseId1
| extend
    _case = parse_json(dspmCase),
    _ds = parse_json(datasource),
    _exp = parse_json(expand),
    CaseClassifiers = coalesce(
        iff(array_length(_joinedClassifiers) > 0, _joinedClassifiers, dynamic(null)),
        iff(array_length(parse_json(tostring(_classifiersRaw))) > 0, parse_json(tostring(_classifiersRaw)), dynamic(null)),
        dynamic([])
    )
| extend
    _obj = iif(gettype(_exp) == 'array', _exp[0], _exp),
    SampleEvidence = iif(gettype(_exp) == 'array', _exp, pack_array(_exp))
| extend
    CaseInternalId = tostring(_case.id),
    CaseLabel = tostring(_case.caseLabel),
    PolicyName = tostring(_case.policyName),
    PolicyFqdn = tostring(_case.policyFqdn),
    PolicyType = tostring(_case.policyType),
    PolicyDescription = tostring(_case.policyDescription),
    Compliance = tostring(_case.compliance),
    Severity = tolower(tostring(_case.severityLevel)),
    SentinelSeverity = case(
        tostring(_case.severityLevel) in~ ('critical', 'high'), 'High',
        tostring(_case.severityLevel) =~ 'medium', 'Medium',
        tostring(_case.severityLevel) =~ 'low', 'Low',
        'Informational'
    ),
    Status = tolower(tostring(_case.caseStatus)),
    CaseType = tostring(_case.caseType),
    Assignee = tostring(_case.assignee),
    PolicyOwner = tostring(_case.policyOwner),
    AffectedObjectsCount = toint(_case.numberOfAffectedObjects),
    RemediatedObjectsCount = toint(_case.numberOfRemediatedObjects),
    IsRemediated = tobool(_case.isRemediated),
    PolicyLastTriggered = todatetime(_case.policyLastTriggered),
    CaseCreatedAt = todatetime(_case.created_at),
    CaseUpdatedAt = todatetime(_case.updated_at),
    DataSourceName = tostring(_case.dataSourceName),
    DataSourceType = tostring(_case.dataSourceType),
    DataSourceDisplayName = tostring(_case.dataSourceDisplayName),
    Vendor = tostring(_ds.vendor),
    Environment = tostring(_ds.environments[0]),
    SystemId = tostring(_ds.systemId),
    CloudIdentifier = iif(tostring(_ds.cloudIdentifier) == 'arn:bigid:s3:::all_buckets', '', tostring(_ds.cloudIdentifier)),
    CloudAccount = tostring(_ds.cloudAccount),
    CloudRegion = case(
        isnotempty(tostring(_ds.cloudRegion)), tostring(_ds.cloudRegion),
        isnotempty(tostring(_ds.location)), tostring(_ds.location),
        ''
    ),
    CloudPlatform = case(
        tostring(_ds.cloudIdentifier) startswith 'arn:', 'AWS',
        tostring(_ds.cloudIdentifier) startswith '/subscriptions/', 'AZURE',
        tostring(_ds.cloudIdentifier) matches regex @"^//[a-z0-9-]+\.googleapis\.com/", 'GCP',
        tostring(_ds.environments[0])
    ),
    CloudResourceInstance = case(
        isnotempty(tostring(_ds.cloudIdentifier)) and tostring(_ds.cloudIdentifier) != 'arn:bigid:s3:::all_buckets', tostring(_ds.cloudIdentifier),
        isnotempty(tostring(_ds.systemId)), tostring(_ds.systemId),
        tostring(_case.dataSourceName)
    ),
    AzureResourceId = iif(tostring(_ds.cloudIdentifier) startswith '/subscriptions/', tolower(tostring(_ds.cloudIdentifier)), ''),
    SecurityTier = tostring(_ds.security_tier),
    ObjectId = tostring(_obj.id),
    ObjectName = tostring(_obj.objectName),
    ObjectPath = tostring(_obj.fullObjectName),
    _dir = extract('^(.+)[/\\\\][^/\\\\]+$', 1, tostring(_obj.fullObjectName)),
    ObjectDirectory = iif(isnotempty(extract('^(.+)[/\\\\][^/\\\\]+$', 1, tostring(_obj.fullObjectName))), extract('^(.+)[/\\\\][^/\\\\]+$', 1, tostring(_obj.fullObjectName)), tostring(_obj.containerName)),
    FullyQualifiedName = tostring(_obj.fullyQualifiedName),
    ContainerName = tostring(_obj.containerName),
    ObjectType = tostring(_obj.objectType),
    DetailedObjectType = tostring(_obj.detailedObjectType),
    ObjectSizeInBytes = tolong(_obj.sizeInBytes),
    TotalPiiCount = toint(_obj.total_pii_count),
    Classifications = _obj.attribute,
    ObjectTags = _obj.tags,
    SharedWith = _obj.sharedWith,
    SharedWithGroup = _obj.sharedWithGroup,
    LastScanned = todatetime(_obj.last_scanned),
    ObjectOwner = case(
        isnotempty(tostring(_obj.owner)) and tostring(_obj.owner) != '[]', tostring(_obj.owner),
        isnotempty(tostring(_case.dataSourceOwner)) and tostring(_case.dataSourceOwner) != '[]', tostring(_case.dataSourceOwner),
        ''
    ),
    ProviderName = 'BigID',
    ProductName = 'BigID DSPM',
    ProductComponentName = 'Data Risk Management',
    BigIDCasePath = strcat('/#/data-risk-management?caseId=', tostring(_case.id)),
    BigIDCaseUrl = iif(isnotempty(BigIDFqdn), strcat('https://', BigIDFqdn, '/#/data-risk-management?caseId=', tostring(_case.id)), ''),
    BigIDScanAnalysisPath = '/#/scan-analysis'
| project

    PolicyType,

    Compliance,
    Severity,

    SampleEvidence,
    ProviderName,
    ProductName,
    ProductComponentName,
    BigIDFqdn,
    BigIDCasePath,
    BigIDCaseUrl,
    BigIDScanAnalysisPath

| join kind=leftouter _caseClassifiers on CaseId
| project-away CaseId1
| extend
    _case = parse_json(dspmCase),
    _ds = parse_json(datasource),
    _exp = parse_json(expand),
    CaseClassifiers = coalesce(
        iff(array_length(_joinedClassifiers) > 0, _joinedClassifiers, dynamic(null)),
        iff(array_length(parse_json(tostring(_classifiersRaw))) > 0, parse_json(tostring(_classifiersRaw)), dynamic(null)),
        dynamic([])
    )
| extend
    _obj = iif(gettype(_exp) == 'array', _exp[0], _exp),
    SampleEvidence = iif(gettype(_exp) == 'array', _exp, pack_array(_exp))
| extend
    CaseInternalId = tostring(_case.id),
    CaseLabel = tostring(_case.caseLabel),
    PolicyName = tostring(_case.policyName),
    PolicyFqdn = tostring(_case.policyFqdn),
    PolicyType = tostring(_case.policyType),
    PolicyDescription = tostring(_case.policyDescription),
    Compliance = tostring(_case.compliance),
    Severity = tolower(tostring(_case.severityLevel)),
    SentinelSeverity = case(
        tostring(_case.severityLevel) in~ ('critical', 'high'), 'High',
        tostring(_case.severityLevel) =~ 'medium', 'Medium',
        tostring(_case.severityLevel) =~ 'low', 'Low',
        'Informational'
    ),
    Status = tolower(tostring(_case.caseStatus)),
    CaseType = tostring(_case.caseType),
    Assignee = tostring(_case.assignee),
    PolicyOwner = tostring(_case.policyOwner),
    AffectedObjectsCount = toint(_case.numberOfAffectedObjects),
    RemediatedObjectsCount = toint(_case.numberOfRemediatedObjects),
    IsRemediated = tobool(_case.isRemediated),
    PolicyLastTriggered = todatetime(_case.policyLastTriggered),
    CaseCreatedAt = todatetime(_case.created_at),
    CaseUpdatedAt = todatetime(_case.updated_at),
    DataSourceName = tostring(_case.dataSourceName),
    DataSourceType = tostring(_case.dataSourceType),
    DataSourceDisplayName = tostring(_case.dataSourceDisplayName),
    Vendor = tostring(_ds.vendor),
    Environment = tostring(_ds.environments[0]),
    SystemId = tostring(_ds.systemId),
    CloudIdentifier = iif(tostring(_ds.cloudIdentifier) == 'arn:bigid:s3:::all_buckets', '', tostring(_ds.cloudIdentifier)),
    CloudAccount = tostring(_ds.cloudAccount),
    CloudRegion = case(
        isnotempty(tostring(_ds.cloudRegion)), tostring(_ds.cloudRegion),
        isnotempty(tostring(_ds.location)), tostring(_ds.location),
        ''
    ),
    CloudPlatform = case(
        tostring(_ds.cloudIdentifier) startswith 'arn:', 'AWS',
        tostring(_ds.cloudIdentifier) startswith '/subscriptions/', 'AZURE',
        tostring(_ds.cloudIdentifier) matches regex @"^//[a-z0-9-]+\.googleapis\.com/", 'GCP',
        tostring(_ds.environments[0])
    ),
    CloudResourceInstance = case(
        isnotempty(tostring(_ds.cloudIdentifier)) and tostring(_ds.cloudIdentifier) != 'arn:bigid:s3:::all_buckets', tostring(_ds.cloudIdentifier),
        isnotempty(tostring(_ds.systemId)), tostring(_ds.systemId),
        tostring(_case.dataSourceName)
    ),
    AzureResourceId = iif(tostring(_ds.cloudIdentifier) startswith '/subscriptions/', tolower(tostring(_ds.cloudIdentifier)), ''),
    SecurityTier = tostring(_ds.security_tier),
    ObjectId = tostring(_obj.id),
    ObjectName = tostring(_obj.objectName),
    ObjectPath = tostring(_obj.fullObjectName),
    _dir = extract('^(.+)[/\\\\][^/\\\\]+$', 1, tostring(_obj.fullObjectName)),
    ObjectDirectory = iif(isnotempty(extract('^(.+)[/\\\\][^/\\\\]+$', 1, tostring(_obj.fullObjectName))), extract('^(.+)[/\\\\][^/\\\\]+$', 1, tostring(_obj.fullObjectName)), tostring(_obj.containerName)),
    FullyQualifiedName = tostring(_obj.fullyQualifiedName),
    ContainerName = tostring(_obj.containerName),
    ObjectType = tostring(_obj.objectType),
    DetailedObjectType = tostring(_obj.detailedObjectType),
    ObjectSizeInBytes = tolong(_obj.sizeInBytes),
    TotalPiiCount = toint(_obj.total_pii_count),
    Classifications = _obj.attribute,
    ObjectTags = _obj.tags,
    SharedWith = _obj.sharedWith,
    SharedWithGroup = _obj.sharedWithGroup,
    LastScanned = todatetime(_obj.last_scanned),
    ObjectOwner = case(
        isnotempty(tostring(_obj.owner)) and tostring(_obj.owner) != '[]', tostring(_obj.owner),
        isnotempty(tostring(_case.dataSourceOwner)) and tostring(_case.dataSourceOwner) != '[]', tostring(_case.dataSourceOwner),
        ''
    ),
    ProviderName = 'BigID',
    ProductName = 'BigID DSPM',
    ProductComponentName = 'Data Risk Management',
    BigIDCasePath = strcat('/#/data-risk-management?caseId=', tostring(_case.id)),
    BigIDCaseUrl = iif(isnotempty(BigIDFqdn), strcat('https://', BigIDFqdn, '/#/data-risk-management?caseId=', tostring(_case.id)), ''),
    BigIDScanAnalysisPath = '/#/scan-analysis'
| project
    TimeGenerated,
    CaseId,
    CaseInternalId,
    CaseLabel,
    PolicyName,
    PolicyFqdn,
    PolicyType,
    PolicyDescription,
    Compliance,
    Severity,
    SentinelSeverity,
    Status,
    CaseType,
    Assignee,
    PolicyOwner,
    AffectedObjectsCount,
    RemediatedObjectsCount,
    IsRemediated,
    PolicyLastTriggered,
    CaseCreatedAt,
    CaseUpdatedAt,
    DataSourceName,
    DataSourceType,
    DataSourceDisplayName,
    Vendor,
    Environment,
    SystemId,
    CloudPlatform,
    CloudAccount,
    CloudRegion,
    CloudIdentifier,
    CloudResourceInstance,
    AzureResourceId,
    SecurityTier,
    ObjectId,
    ObjectName,
    ObjectPath,
    ObjectDirectory,
    FullyQualifiedName,
    ContainerName,
    ObjectType,
    DetailedObjectType,
    ObjectSizeInBytes,
    TotalPiiCount,
    Classifications,
    CaseClassifiers,
    ObjectTags,
    SharedWith,
    SharedWithGroup,
    LastScanned,
    ObjectOwner,
    SampleEvidence,
    ProviderName,
    ProductName,
    ProductComponentName,
    BigIDFqdn,
    BigIDCasePath,
    BigIDCaseUrl,
    BigIDScanAnalysisPath

properties.descriptionHtml:
Note: Please refer to the following before installing the solution:

• Review the solution Release Notes

• There may be known issues pertaining to this Solution, please refer to them before installing.

The BigID solution for Microsoft Sentinel enables you to ingest BigID DSPM cases, classifier inventory, data source context, and affected catalog objects into Microsoft Sentinel, with a normalizing KQL parser (BigIDDSPMCases), an interactive DSPM Posture & Case Triage Workbook, and an on-demand 1,000-object evidence Playbook.

Underlying Microsoft Technologies used:

This solution takes a dependency on the following technologies, and some of these dependencies either may be in Preview state or might result in additional ingestion or operational costs:

  1. Codeless Connector Framework (CCF) and Azure Monitor Logs Ingestion API

  2. Azure Logic Apps

Data Connectors: 1, Parsers: 1, Workbooks: 1, Playbooks: 1
